title: Recoverability is the accessible fraction of encoded structure

statements.text: The recoverability functional $R = I_{\mathrm{acc}} / I_{\mathrm{tot}}$ is the fraction of the physically encoded structure that finite observers can reconstruct within a regime. It is a bookkeeping measure across regimes, not a new entropy.

sources.quote: which measures the fraction of physically encoded structure recoverable by finite observers within a given regime.
It is a cross-regime bookkeeping functional that tracks the same structural limitation under different physical realisations.
